title: v1 error body
description: The ONE error shape every v1 route returns on failure. Clients branch on the stable `code`; `message` is human-readable and may change. Replaces today's ad-hoc {error:"<string>"} with inconsistent status codes.

code.description: Stable machine code. See the HTTP-status mapping in docs/V1-CONTRACT.md.

message.description: Human-readable detail. May change between releases; do not parse.

retry_after_s.description: Present only for code=rate_limited: seconds to wait before retrying.
